agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #28 (pt-BR date formatting, week-strip weekdays, English guard test) on branch ant/issue-28. Changed all 5 toLocaleDateString calls in app.js to pass 'pt-BR' explicitly instead of undefined; switched deadline due-date/week-heading formatting to numeric dd/mm/aaaa; switched week-strip weekday letters from 'narrow' to 'short' for disambiguation. Added 6 new/extended Playwright tests (locale forced to en-US to prove the hard-coded pt-BR output) covering the date heading, numeric due dates, week-strip accessible names/distinct abbreviations, origin labels, the English-word guard test (manually verified it fails against a reverted string), and a fully-populated pt-BR screenshot test. Extended an existing 360px test with week-strip-specific no-scroll assertions. Documented all decisions in DECISIONS.md. All 80 tests pass (up from 74, none removed). Opened PR #31.
